chunks: Al-Fudhayl ibn Yasar narrated from Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
There is no Jumu'ah, nor Eid al-Adha, nor Eid al-Fitr during travel.

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.أَضْحَى: Eid al-Adha; here referring to its prayer
key_terms.السَّفَرِ: travel; the state of journeying that affects certain legal obligations
key_terms.فِطْرٌ: Eid al-Fitr; here referring to its prayer

ai.seo_question: Are Jumu'ah and Eid prayers required for a traveler in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning acts of worship during travel. It states that the traveler is not obligated with Jumu'ah prayer, Eid al-Adha prayer, or Eid al-Fitr prayer while in a state of سفر.
